name: Pan American Health Organization
body: Preloaded HSTS, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, and robots.txt that keeps AI training bots off paginated news only. But no page read carries JSON-LD saying who PAHO is.
lesson: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, logo, url, and sameAs. It helps AI answers name the right agency.
summary: www.paho.org scores 82 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 20 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 23 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 23 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en, /en/paho-editor/login, /es, /pt and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 26 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 10 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /en/countries-and-centers (67), /en/pahowho-collaborating-centres (76), /en/regional-revolving-fund (70), /en/alliance-primary-health-care-americas (94) and 6 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.
